title: The Impatient Little Snail: Slow and Steady Always Wins!

lines.text: Sammy the snail crawled along the mossy path, inch by steady inch!
lines.caps: Sammy the snail crawled along the *MOSSY | path, inch by *STEADY | *INCH!

lines.text: He watched hummingbirds zip and bunnies sprint across the garden grass!
lines.caps: He watched hummingbirds *ZIP | and bunnies sprint across the *GARDEN | *GRASS!

lines.text: I want to be fast right now! Sammy grumbled, trying to slide at super speed!
lines.caps: I want to be *FAST | right now! Sammy grumbled, trying to *SLIDE | at super *SPEED!

lines.text: Zoom! Speedy rabbit dashed past like a whirlwind, not looking where he was going!
lines.caps: *ZOOM! Speedy rabbit dashed *PAST | like a whirlwind, not looking *WHERE | he was *GOING!

lines.text: Whoosh—CRASH! Rabbit tripped over a garden hose and lost his strawberry basket!
lines.caps: Whoosh—*CRASH! | Rabbit tripped over a garden hose and *LOST | his strawberry *BASKET!

lines.text: Sammy steadily glided forward, picking up each strawberry with careful care!
lines.caps: Sammy steadily glided *FORWARD, | picking up each strawberry with *CAREFUL | *CARE!

lines.text: He delivered the basket safely without bruising a single delicious fruit!
lines.caps: He delivered the basket *SAFELY | without bruising a single *DELICIOUS | *FRUIT!

lines.text: Slow and steady finishes the race with patience and excellence!
lines.caps: Slow and steady finishes the *RACE | with patience and *EXCELLENCE!

lines.text: Take your time and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo for fun learning!
lines.caps: *TAKE your time | and *SUBSCRIBE to | *BABYBEATS Rhymo | for fun *LEARNING!
